raw_record.question_text:
At 8:43 on June 14, 2008, Tokyo time, a magnitude 7.2 earthquake on the Richter scale occurred in northeastern Japan, with the focus located 15 km underground. The Japan Meteorological Agency used the “Earthquake Early Warning” system in some areas this time, gaining several seconds of varying length for residents in various places to take earthquake avoidance measures, thereby greatly reducing the losses brought by the earthquake disaster. The solid line in the figure is the graph of seismic wave velocity changing with depth:

<image1>

After the earthquake occurred, about how many seconds did the local seismic network gain for local residents to take emergency avoidance through the “Earthquake Early Warning System”?

method.method_draft: 先看图：实线图中左侧标“横波”的曲线在0—33 km深度范围内速度约为4.2—4.6 km/s，震源15 km处对应的横波速度约4.3 km/s左右。再读题干：震源位于地下15 km，要求估算紧急地震速报为地面居民赢得的避震时间。把地震预警电信号传播时间近似看作瞬时，主要等待的是破坏性较强、传播较慢的横波从震源传到地面所需时间。用公式 t = 距离 / 速度，t ≈ 15 km ÷ 4.3 km/s ≈ 3.5 s，按题目“约多少秒”取近似值为4 s。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中纵轴为深度（km），从地表0 km向下到约33 km；横轴为地震波传播速度，单位为km·s^-1，上方标有4.2、4.6、7.6、8.1等刻度。实线中左侧曲线标为“横波”，在0—33 km深度范围内速度约为4.2—4.6 km/s；右侧曲线标为“纵波”，速度约为7.6—8.1 km/s。推理：题干给出震源深度为15 km，紧急地震速报的电信号传播时间可近似看作很短，居民主要赢得的是破坏性较强、速度较慢的横波到达地面前的时间。由图读出15 km深度附近横波速度约为4.3 km/s，用t=距离/速度，t≈15 km÷4.3 km/s≈3.5 s，取近似值约为4 s。
